exposure: first trimester multiple of medians (MOM) of pregnancy-associated plasma protein-A (PAPP-A) and Beta human chorionic gonadotropin (B hCG)
cohort: The study involved 80 patients with HELLP syndrome and 135 controls.
finding: Low first-trimester PAPP-A levels and high second-trimester B hCG levels may be associated with HELLP syndrome.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
